title: Dataset of breast ultrasound images

license.text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/This is an open access article under the CC BY license (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

paragraphs.en: The data collected at baseline include breast ultrasound images among women in ages between 25 and 75 years old. This data was collected in 2018. The number of patients is 600 female patients. The dataset consists of 780 images with an average image size of 500 × 500 pixels. The images are in PNG format. The images are categorized into three classes, which are normal, benign, and malignant. The number of images in each class is shown in Table 1. The data samples are illustrated in Fig. 1. Samples of original images and the images after preprocessing are shown in Fig. 2 and Fig. 3, respectively. Furthermore, each image has its own ground truth (mask image) as shown in Fig. 4.
paragraphs.zh: 基线收集的数据包括25至75岁女性的乳腺超声图像。这些数据于2018年收集，共涉及600名女性患者。数据集包含780幅图像，平均图像尺寸为500 × 500像素，采用PNG格式。图像分为正常、良性和恶性三类，各类图像数量见表1。数据样本见图1。原始图像和预处理后图像的示例分别见图2和图3。此外，每幅图像均有对应的真实标注（掩膜图像），见图4。

paragraphs.en: Ultrasound (US) images are generally in grayscale. They were collected and stored in a DICOM format at Baheya hospital. The consumed time used to collect and annotate the images is about one year. US dataset is categorized into three classes: normal, benign, and malignant. At the beginning, the number of images collected was 1100. After performing preprocessing to the dataset, the number of images was reduced to 780 images. The original images contain unimportant information not used for mass classification. Moreover, they may affect the output results of the training process. The instruments used in the scanning process are LOGIQ E9 ultrasound system and LOGIQ E9 Agile ultrasound system. These instruments are usually used in top-notch imaging for radiology, cardiac and vascular application. They produce image resolution of 1280*1024. The transducers are 1–5 MHz on ML6-15-D Matrix linear probe. Fig. 2 Illustrates a sample of the original scanned images.
paragraphs.zh: 超声（US）图像通常为灰度图像。这些图像在Baheya医院收集，并以DICOM格式保存。收集和标注图像耗时约一年。超声数据集分为正常、良性和恶性三类。最初共收集1100幅图像，预处理后减少为780幅。原始图像包含不用于肿块分类的非关键信息，这些信息还可能影响训练过程的输出结果。扫描使用LOGIQ E9超声系统和LOGIQ E9 Agile超声系统。这些设备通常用于放射、心脏和血管领域的高端成像，生成的图像分辨率为1280 × 1024。采用ML6-15-D矩阵线阵探头，换能器频率为1–5 MHz。图2展示了原始扫描图像的示例。

paragraphs.en: To make the dataset useful, some tasks should be performed. The data included duplicated images that required to be removed. Furthermore, radiologists from Baheya reviewed and fixed the incorrect annotation. DICOM images were converted to PNG format by using a DICOM converter application [2]. After refining the dataset, the number of US images was reduced to 780 images. The images are categorized into three classes (cases), which are normal, benign, and malignant. All images were cropped to different sizes to remove unused and unimportant boundaries from the images. We used fast photo crop [3] for this task. The image annotation is added to the image name. Special radiologists at Baheya hospital reviewed and checked all images. An example of the refined images is shown in Fig. 3.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使数据集适于使用，需要完成若干处理步骤。数据中存在需要删除的重复图像。此外，Baheya医院的放射科医师复核并纠正了错误标注。使用DICOM转换应用程序[2]将DICOM图像转为PNG格式。整理数据集后，超声图像数量减少至780幅，分为正常、良性和恶性三类。所有图像均裁剪为不同尺寸，以去除不使用且不重要的边缘区域；该任务使用fast photo crop软件[3]完成。图像标注被加入图像名称。Baheya医院的专科放射科医师复核并检查了全部图像。图3展示了整理后的图像示例。

paragraphs.en: Ground truth (image boundary) is performed to make the ultrasound dataset beneficial. Matlab [4] is used to perform this step. A freehand segmentation is established for each image separately. An example of mask images is shown in Fig. 4. Three folders are created for each type of breast cancer categories. Each folder has the images of its class. The image name includes the name of the class and the number of the image. Furthermore, the name of the masked image has the name as the US images with adding “_mask” to the end name of the image.
paragraphs.zh: 为使超声数据集具有实用价值，制作了真实标注，即图像边界。本步骤使用Matlab[4]完成，对每幅图像分别进行手工自由轮廓分割，掩膜图像示例见图4。为三种乳腺类别分别创建文件夹，每个文件夹包含相应类别的图像。图像名称包含类别名称和图像编号。掩膜图像名称与对应超声图像名称相同，但在名称末尾增加“_mask”。

paragraphs.en: Researchers are mindful of the fact that patients have a right to be protected from public scrutiny of their private lives and illness. To this end, the researcher ensured that the patients and the hospital were adequately informed about the objective of this study. In addition, every patient's data stays unknown and his or her illness states is with the utmost confidentiality.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员认识到，患者有权使其私生活和疾病信息免受公众审视。因此，研究人员确保患者及医院充分了解本研究目的。此外，每位患者的数据保持匿名，其疾病状况受到严格保密。

paragraphs.en: The authors would like to appreciate the management of Baheya hospital for granting permission to obtain and use medical images for this research work. Furthermore, the authors would like to thank Dr. Mohamed Hamed for his support for managing the dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者感谢Baheya医院管理层批准本研究获取和使用医学图像。此外，作者感谢Mohamed Hamed医师对数据集管理工作的支持。

rows: Value of the Data•Ultrasound scan is mostly used for examination and early detection of breast cancer. Moreover, it is safe in comparison to other radiology imaging techniques.•Breast Ultrasound dataset can be used to train machine learning models which can classify, detect and segment early signs of masses or micro-calcification in breast cancer.•Researchers with interest in classification, detection, and segmentation of breast cancer can utilize this data of breast ultrasound images, combine it with others' datasets, and analyze them for further insights.•The data is comprehensive, containing breast cancer states (normal, benign, and malignant).•This dataset is – to our best knowledge – the first breast ultrasound dataset publically available.
tables.xml:
Value of the Data

Ultrasound scan is mostly used for examination and early detection of breast cancer. Moreover, it is safe in comparison to other radiology imaging techniques.

Breast Ultrasound dataset can be used to train machine learning models which can classify, detect and segment early signs of masses or micro-calcification in breast cancer.

Researchers with interest in classification, detection, and segmentation of breast cancer can utilize this data of breast ultrasound images, combine it with others' datasets, and analyze them for further insights.

The data is comprehensive, containing breast cancer states (normal, benign, and malignant).

This dataset is – to our best knowledge – the first breast ultrasound dataset publically available.
rows_zh: 数据价值：•超声扫描常用于乳腺癌检查和早期发现，与其他放射影像技术相比也具有安全性优势。•乳腺超声数据集可用于训练机器学习模型，以分类、检测和分割乳腺癌中肿块或微钙化的早期征象。•从事乳腺癌分类、检测及分割研究的人员可使用该乳腺超声图像数据，将其与其他数据集结合分析，以获得更多认识。•该数据集内容全面，包含正常、良性和恶性状态。•据作者所知，这是首个公开可获取的乳腺超声数据集。
